title: Anthropic should give stock to Stack Overflow (and OpenAI too)
author: thetjmccarty
snippet: Anthropic and OpenAI should give Stack Overflow a percentage of their company. They used all of Stack Overflow's data to train their AI models at the beginning of LLMs without paying for it because it was publicly available online. ChatGPT and Claude would not exist today…
excerpt: Anthropic and OpenAI should give Stack Overflow a percentage of their company. They used all of Stack Overflow's data to train their AI models at the beginning of LLMs without paying for it because it was publicly available online. ChatGPT and Claude would not exist today without the 24 million coding questions and 36 million answers with code examples included, all created by real humans who took the time to write the questions and answers. Stack Overflow deserves to be rewarded for making Anthropic and OpenAI such a success. And all the developers who posted and answered questions on Stack Overflow should be given stock too.

title: Show HN: Local Graph for Your Agents
author: vmikhailov
snippet: We all use different agentic systems, bots, chats, and so on. One day I realized that I need to copy context between the apps. It is annoying. So I created a trivial local MCP which sits on top of SQLite and exposes Cypher so LLM can query anything. Also LLM can define a schema…
excerpt: We all use different agentic systems, bots, chats, and so on. One day I realized that I need to copy context between the apps. It is annoying. So I created a trivial local MCP which sits on top of SQLite and exposes Cypher so LLM can query anything. Also LLM can define a schema if it understands it needs new nodes or edges. How do I use it: 1. I've scanned all my documents and stored passports, driver licences and all kind of contracts for my apartment, insurance and so on. And not only mine - the entire family. 2. I've extracted all the key date and values. Also gemini extracted all the personal relations. Like "Alex is-a-child-of Bob". "Bob is-married-to Anna". So i can ask "give me a passport number of my son" and it gives it back instantly. It might not be a big deal, but it is very convenient. 3. It stores all the projects I'm working on, key steps and decisions. 4. And the most important thing - it works from anywhere. I can ask Hermes i telegram to remind me when my insurance ends or I can reference my project in ClaudeCode just by name and it will get the entire history from Antigravity. I would be happy if you guys find it useful.

Clean and prepare that data for training an open-source model (Add the ability to scan, control, defend on any misbehaviour with the system). 3.
